title: Levo X Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Engineered for adaptable touring, the Caberg Levo X Gloss Black is delivers one-handed chin bar actuation paired with certified dual-homologation protection across highway and urban riding. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1280g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~89 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Carbon shell modular with panoramic visor and antibacterial lining.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for an Intermediate Oval head shape; features a semi-fairing chin bar that creates a snug fit around the cheeks and jawline typical of Caberg's Levo series.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Caberg Levo X Gloss Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Caberg's Modular lineup, the Levo X Gloss Black brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Caberg Levo X Gloss Black represents Caberg's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~89 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Caberg Levo X Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
